The only checkpoints marked present were generic functional aspects (straps, ornamental details) that happen to exist in both armor types but do not satisfy the specific class definition.

The complexity of the scale mail lacing is rendered cleanly without AI 'smearing'.

The image is a valid piece of armor but an invalid instance of the specific 'breastplate' class.
artifact_reasoning: The image is structurally sound and visually clean. Experts detected no graphics-level distortions (noise, blur) or topological errors (fragmentation, boundary bleeding). The intricate details of the scales and lacing are sharp and coherent. The high artifact score reflects the high fidelity of the image content, despite the class misalignment.
